status: OPTIONS FOR THE PRODUCT OWNER — none executed, no option authorized, $0.00 spent
purpose: The §183 design cannot be run as specified. These are the paths that remain, with what each buys and what each cannot answer. The choice is the owner's because each trades a different thing away.

OPTION_1.name: PRODUCT OWNER SUPPLIES THE OWED FACTS
OPTION_1.shape: the product owner writes, for each of the ten frozen rows, the material unresolved fact — factKey, why it is unresolved, both branches and the decision divergence — filling the MATERIAL_UNRESOLVED_FACTS field that has been null since §174
buys: the stimulus stops being model-authored, so the HR-04 result becomes interpretable
it closes the gap §175 first hit and that has blocked strict scoring three times since
it is reusable — every future settlement experiment on this instrument needs the same content
costs: real product-owner authoring labour on ten rows
the authored facts then need the same care as any evaluation truth: authored before seeing outputs, and never revised to fit a result
OPTION_1.risk: the owner writing HR-04's fact faces the same tension I do — a specific wording states the distinction. The difference is that an owner-authored stimulus is a legitimate instrument, where a model-authored one evaluating that same model is the closed loop the programme has refused since §162.
OPTION_1.recommendationIfChosen: author blind to the §179 results and to this analysis's candidate wordings, and freeze before any run

OPTION_2.name: TWO-ROW HUMAN-AUTHORITATIVE COHORT (HS-A1, HS-E1)
OPTION_2.shape: run the §183 settlement path only on the two rows whose owed-fact targets are human-authoritative from §162 and human-reviewed at §169
OPTION_2.providerCalls: 6 at three replicates, well inside the caps
buys: genuinely authoritative owed-fact content, authored by nobody for this experiment
a real reviewability measurement on real challenge reasons — the question that decides whether a declaration field is justified
cannotAnswer: HR-04 false settlement — the primary target is not in this cohort
containment (HR-05/HR-07 shapes) — both rows are REQUIRED-shaped and HUMAN_AUTHORITATIVE_SILENCE_ROWS for owed-fact content is 0
OPTION_2.caveat: these are the rows §167 already spent, so a result here is not independent of that history
OPTION_2.verdict: the cheapest honest experiment available today, and it answers the declaration-field question while leaving the safety question open

OPTION_3.name: GOVERNED-DERIVED OWED FACTS, ACCEPTING THE COARSENESS
OPTION_3.shape: construct owed facts only from approved-record requiredFacts and evidenceQuestions, deterministically, with no narrative authored by anyone
OPTION_3.providerCalls: 30 at three replicates over ten rows
buys: zero authoring — the stimulus is entirely governed-derived and reproducible
it measures what the architecture would actually do in production, where governed framing is all it has
cannotAnswer: HR-04 — app-mg-01 frames the fact as guarding_status, which does not distinguish presence from securement, so the property under test is not expressible in the stimulus
OPTION_3.whatItWouldActuallyMeasure: whether a model can settle or challenge COARSE governed facts reviewably — which is a real and useful question, and is NOT the question §183 asked
OPTION_3.verdict: valid experiment, different question. Choosing it means accepting that §183's primary target is deferred to Option 1 or to governed remediation.

OPTION_4.name: GOVERNED EVIDENCE ALIGNMENT REMEDIATION FIRST
OPTION_4.shape: address the §181 finding before any settlement behaviour validation — decide whether a functional-test verification method belongs in the vocabulary, and disambiguate the two ambiguous evidence questions
OPTION_4.rationale: the reason HR-04's owed fact cannot be constructed from governed sources is that the registry has no method establishing that a safeguard works. That is the same finding that will block a reviewer from approving settlement on any protective-function fact once the run happens.
OPTION_4.buys: removes the root cause of both the construction blocker and the anticipated review blocker
OPTION_4.costs: a knowledge-governance programme of unknown size, and governed records must never be strengthened merely to make a tool work
OPTION_4.verdict: the authorization's own GOVERNED-KNOWLEDGE DECISION RULE points here — the dominant reason the experiment cannot proceed is that the governed criterion is incapable

OPTION_5.name: RUN THE REVIEWABILITY HALF KNOWINGLY, ON AUTHORED FACTS
OPTION_5.shape: proceed as §183 specifies, with model-authored owed facts, but preregister that criteria 6, 7 and 8 are VOID BY CONSTRUCTION and score only criteria 1-5 and 9-10
OPTION_5.buys: an answer to the declaration-field question on the full ten-row instrument
costs: $1.50 and the owner's review time on up to 30 claim packets
the primary safety target is explicitly not measured, and the record must say so permanently
every challenge is a response to a stimulus this model wrote — the §167 confound, knowingly incurred
OPTION_5.verdict: legitimate if the owner wants the reviewability answer now and accepts the recorded void. It is the owner's call to spend money and review labour on a partial instrument, not mine to make by proceeding quietly.

whatIsNotAnOption: authoring the owed facts myself and running the full design as though the result were interpretable — this is the closed loop refused since §162, and §167 already recorded the confound it produces
strengthening a governed record so the owed fact becomes constructible
weakening the preregistered criteria so the available instrument passes them

recommendation.primary: OPTION_1 — product owner supplies the owed facts, then re-run §183 as written
recommendation.why: it is the only path that answers §183's primary question, and the missing content has now blocked scoring at §175, §177, §179 and here. It is a one-time cost that unblocks a recurring obstacle.
recommendation.ifOwnerWantsAnAnswerSooner: OPTION_2 alongside it — six calls, real human-authoritative targets, and it settles the declaration-field question independently of the HR-04 question
recommendation.parallel: OPTION_4 remains the standing parallel track from §180 and §181, unchanged and now with a second reason behind it
